name: datepicker
title: Datepicker
description: A date field that opens Materialize's modal calendar, or an anchored popover, with typing, i18n and form support.
improvements: onOpenChange fires on every close path, including Esc and overlay click (#6500); focus is trapped and returned to the field.
A date typed in the field is respected when the picker opens (#6575), and typed dates are parsed in the user's locale.
readOnly and disabled fields never open the picker (#6538).
Controlled or uncontrolled value as a Date, submitted in forms as yyyy-mm-dd through a hidden input.
Popover variant with collision-aware positioning, and a header-on-top layout on small screens.
